_comment: Lighthouse budgets (see .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml). performance = minimum score, lcp/tbt in ms (max), cls (max), scriptKb = max transferred JavaScript in KB. The bound pages /, /changelog and /guide stay advisory (a miss is a warning; the job stays green). Do not loosen these budgets, and do not make the Lighthouse job a required check. Shared runners are noisy; re-run before acting on a lone miss.
